A '''v'ris''' was a kind of [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]] found on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]],<ref name="GCG" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The planet's native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], would often use "V'ris" as a first name for some of their [[Gender/Legends|female]] members.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The v'ris gemstones were first mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]]. They were only described in a table of Sullustan female names.<ref name="GCG" />
